cases.title: Register a new walk-in and check her in
cases.plain: Siti registers a new patient and puts her in the queue.
cases.message: A new patient walks in: Nur Aina binti Hassan, born 14 March 1990, IC ending 4521, phone 012-334 5512, no known allergies, not on a panel. Please register her and check her in.

FD-01.note: Registered with a new patient ID, then in the queue as a walk-in.

cases.title: Record a cash payment, then reconcile the day
cases.plain: Siti records a payment with change due and closes the day's cash.
cases.message: Nurul, IC ending 2758 is paying bill BL-0003 in cash: RM 37.00 due, RM 50.00 handed over. Record it, then reconcile today: I counted RM 84.00 in the cash drawer.

FD-01.note: RM 37.00 recorded with RM 13.00 change; cash RM 84.00 recorded against RM 84.00 counted, no difference.

cases.title: Record a consultation with a prescription, an MC and a return date
cases.plain: Dr Sivakumar records the visit; the next tasks reach Ms Yong and Siti.
cases.message: Suresh Kumar, PS-P-0004: acute gastroenteritis. Prescribe ORS, 1 sachet after each loose stool, up to 4 a day for 2 days, 8 sachets, and paracetamol 1000 mg four times a day when needed for 3 days, 12 tablets. Give a 2-day MC from today and review in 3 days.

GP-01.note: Two lines as said, a 2-day MC, return in 3 days; Ms Yong's check task, Siti's MC and follow-up tasks.

cases.title: View the reconcile result and the owner review list
cases.plain: Dr Sivakumar, as owner, reads the money side without touching it.
cases.message: Show me the reconcile result for Sunday 31 May 2026 and the owner review list.

GP-01.note: The 31 May reconcile (RM 1.00 short) and the owner review list, read only.

cases.title: Check a prescription that passes, dispense and counsel
cases.plain: Ms Yong checks, dispenses and counsels.
cases.message: Check and dispense the prescription for Teoh Boon Hock, PS-P-0005.

PH-01.note: One call: all four checks pass; dispensed, stock reduced, Siti's bill task created.

cases.title: View stock for a medicine
cases.plain: Ms Yong looks up the stock, read only.
cases.message: How many Amoxicillin 500 mg capsules are in stock?

cases.title: Siti asks for case notes
cases.plain: The front desk is refused the case notes.
cases.message: Show me the case notes for Nurul, IC ending 2758.

FD-01.note: Case notes are for the GP only; the reply is written in code.

cases.title: Siti asks to prepare an MC the GP never recorded
cases.plain: An MC is never prepared without the GP's decision.
cases.message: Prepare a 2-day MC for Suresh Kumar, IC ending 3108, who saw Dr Sivakumar this morning.

FD-01.note: No MC in the consultation record; only Dr Sivakumar decides one, during the consultation.

cases.title: Ms Yong tries to prepare a bill
cases.plain: Billing stays with the front desk.
cases.message: Prepare the bill for Ong Kar Mun, PS-P-0017.

PH-01.note: Ms Yong has no billing tool: only Ms Yong's task list is read, nothing changed, and the reply names Siti Kasim.

FD-01.note: Siti may: RM 35.00 consultation plus 7 Cetirizine at RM 0.50, RM 38.50.

cases.title: Dr Sivakumar tries to record a payment
cases.plain: The owner sees the money but does not take it.
cases.message: Record RM 37.00 cash from Nurul, IC ending 2758 for bill BL-0003.

GP-01.note: Dr Sivakumar's billing tool has no record_payment action: no attempt, nothing changed, and the reply names Siti Kasim.

FD-01.note: Siti may: RM 37.00 recorded against BL-0003.

cases.title: Allergy conflict: the GP switches drug
cases.plain: Ms Yong spots the allergy; Dr Sivakumar changes the drug; a new check follows.
cases.message: Check and dispense the prescription for Hidayah, PS-P-0002.

PH-01.note: The check fails on NSAID sensitivity against ibuprofen; code holds the prescription and sends query P1 to Dr Sivakumar.

steps.message: Change Hidayah's ibuprofen to paracetamol 1000 mg four times a day when needed for 5 days, 40 tablets. PS-P-0002.

expect.note: Prescription amended by the GP; the query closed; a new check task for Ms Yong.

cases.title: Out of stock: the GP picks a substitute, the bill follows it
cases.plain: The substitute is chosen by the GP and is what the patient pays for.
cases.message: Check and dispense the prescription for Aisyah, PS-P-0013.

PH-01.note: Cetirizine has no stock; code holds the prescription and sends query P3 to Dr Sivakumar.

steps.message: For Aisyah, PS-P-0013: use loratadine 10 mg once a day for 7 days instead of cetirizine, 7 tablets.

expect.note: Loratadine replaces cetirizine; a new check task for Ms Yong.

steps.message: Check and dispense the amended prescription for Aisyah, PS-P-0013.

expect.note: The new check passes; dispensed in one call.

steps.message: Prepare the bill for Aisyah, PS-P-0013.

expect.note: Priced on the substitute: RM 35.00 plus 7 Loratadine at RM 0.60, RM 39.20.

cases.title: Medicine concern: the GP keeps the prescription
cases.plain: Ms Yong raises a professional concern; Dr Sivakumar decides; Ms Yong dispenses.
cases.message: Wong Kok Wai, PS-P-0063 has asthma and is prescribed ibuprofen. The checks pass, but ask Dr Sivakumar to confirm before I dispense.

PH-01.note: Ms Yong's own concern, in Ms Yong's words; code sets P4 because the checks pass; dispensing held while it is open.

steps.message: Ms Yong's query on Wong Kok Wai, PS-P-0063: keep the ibuprofen as written; the patient has taken it before without trouble.

expect.note: Answer recorded as keep; the hold lifted; notice back to Ms Yong.

steps.message: Dr Sivakumar confirmed. Dispense the prescription for Wong Kok Wai, PS-P-0063.

expect.note: Dispensed in one call after the query was answered to keep it.

cases.title: A clinical issue no policy covers: the GP decides
cases.plain: A matter no policy covers goes to the doctor, and the answer comes back to the desk.
cases.message: Ong Kar Mun, IC ending 2541 brought a prescription from a hospital specialist and asks us to supply the same medicines.

FD-01.note: Matter outside_policy before the consultation: code sends it to Dr Sivakumar as D4; the reply is written in code.

steps.message: Answer Siti on Ong Kar Mun, PS-P-0044: I will review the specialist's prescription when I see the patient, so keep the patient in the queue.

expect.note: The decision goes back to Siti as a notice written in code.

cases.title: Medicine use question: Ms Yong answers behind the scene
cases.plain: The pharmacist answers; the desk passes it on.
cases.message: Hidayah, IC ending 9395 is at the counter and asks whether to take the amoxicillin before or after food, and whether to finish all of it.

FD-01.note: After dispensing, code sends the patient's question to Ms Yong as D5.

steps.message: Answer Siti on Hidayah, PS-P-0024: take it with or after food, three times a day, and finish the whole course even when feeling better.

expect.note: The answer goes back to Siti to pass on.

cases.title: The same question, routed by the stage of the visit
cases.plain: Siti passes the same question twice; code sends it to the doctor before the consultation and to the pharmacist after dispensing.
cases.message: Devi Anandan, IC ending 8494 asks whether the medicine is safe to use with the eczema cream the patient already uses.

FD-01.note: Before the consultation: code sends the question to Dr Sivakumar as D1; Siti names no colleague.

steps.message: Devi Anandan, PS-P-0045: eczema flare with itch. Prescribe loratadine 10 mg once a day for 7 days, 7 tablets.

expect.note: Recorded; code sends the prescription to Ms Yong.

steps.message: Check and dispense the prescription for Devi Anandan, PS-P-0045.

expect.note: Dispensed in one call; Siti's bill task created.

steps.message: Devi Anandan, IC ending 8494 asks again whether the loratadine is safe to use with the eczema cream the patient already uses.

expect.note: After dispensing: the same call, and code sends it to Ms Yong as D5.

cases.title: Standard visit, the process most patients follow
cases.plain: Check-in, consultation, check and dispense, bill and payment: the visit closes.

steps.message: Sandra Yip, IC ending 2040 walks in and is not on a panel. Please check the patient in.
Call the next patient.
Sandra Yip, PS-P-0032: viral fever. Prescribe paracetamol 1000 mg four times a day when needed for 3 days, 12 tablets.
Check and dispense the prescription for Sandra Yip, PS-P-0032.
Prepare the bill for Sandra Yip, IC ending 2040.
Sandra Yip, IC ending 2040 paid RM 37.40 by card. Record it.

cases.title: Referral letter decided in the consultation
cases.plain: The GP decides; Siti prepares it word for word; the GP signs; Siti issues it.

steps.message: Suresh Kumar, PS-P-0033: right knee pain after a fall, possible meniscal tear. No medicines today. Refer soon to the orthopaedic clinic at the general hospital for an MRI and specialist assessment; summary: swelling and locking for 2 weeks, positive McMurray test.
Prepare the referral letter for Suresh Kumar, PS-P-0033.
Dr Sivakumar has signed the referral letter for Suresh Kumar, PS-P-0033. Mark it issued.

cases.title: MC decided in the consultation
cases.plain: The MC is the GP's decision in the consultation, prepared exactly as recorded.

steps.message: Goh Jia Hui, PS-P-0038: acute gastroenteritis. Prescribe ORS, 1 sachet after each loose stool, up to 4 a day for 2 days, 8 sachets. MC for 2 days from today.
Prepare the MC for Goh Jia Hui, PS-P-0038.
Dr Sivakumar has signed the MC for Goh Jia Hui, PS-P-0038. Mark it issued.

cases.title: Panel billing, acknowledged at the end of the day
cases.plain: Siti bills from the fixed panel schedule; Dr Sivakumar reads and acknowledges it.

steps.message: Prepare the bill for Liyana, IC ending 8111, who is on Panel Cempaka.
Liyana, IC ending 8111 paid RM 9.00 in cash, the exact amount. Record it.
Show me today's panel bills and acknowledge the one for Liyana, PS-P-0014.

cases.title: A missing price stops the bill
cases.message: Prepare the bill for Iskandar, PS-P-0047.

expect.note: No price for omeprazole: no bill, nothing estimated.

cases.title: A missing template stops the MC
cases.message: Prepare the MC for Goh Jia Hui, PS-P-0038.

cases.title: A missing stock record stops the check
cases.message: Check and dispense the prescription for Farah, PS-P-0048.

cases.title: A data fault when recording a consultation
cases.message: Suresh Kumar, PS-P-0004: tension headache. Prescribe paracetamol 1000 mg four times a day when needed for 3 days, 12 tablets.
